units.source_text: 她初到这家旅馆，是某年的夏末，正是旅馆缝制新棉袍的时节。

en.t: When she first came to this inn, it was late summer of a certain year, just the season when the inn was sewing new padded robes.

units.source_text: 缝制完了二十几件棉袍，阿雪同时也做好了一件相同花样的男童夹袄，

en.t: After sewing more than twenty padded robes, A-Xue had also made a boy's lined jacket in the same pattern,

units.source_text: 那是她用裁剪剩下的小碎片拼制的。

en.t: It was something she had pieced together from the small scraps left over after cutting the cloth.
It was said to be a gift for her younger brother.
